content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-144. - Appeal to district court.
content.summary:

               provided, shall have the right to appeal to the district court of this state in and

            …

faqs.a:
Any person who has filed objections to the new assessment or reassessment, as hereinbefore
               provided, shall have the right to appeal to the district court of this state in and
               for the county and district in which the city is situated, as provided and subject
               to the limitations in
section 78-103
.
(Code 1981, § 27-144; Ord. No. 551, § 85, 5-14-1964)
